content: Ingestion status UX. Standard state vocabulary across Bedrock KB, Azure AI Search, Dify, Alibaba Tablestore: IN_PROGRESS / INDEXED / PARTIALLY_INDEXED / FAILED. Documented UX failures to avoid: inaccurate progress that fluctuates between batches; status indicators misaligned with actual system state; silent failures where a user cannot distinguish 'complete' from 'stalled'; and - most cited - lack of remediation affordances, i.e. no way to cancel, retry, or un-index a document from the UI. Best practice: per-document status rather than per-batch, exponential backoff retry, smaller sequential batches, explicit cancel for in-flight and retry for failed. PARTIALLY_INDEXED matters: a 200-page PDF where 3 chunks failed must not read as success.
